  type read_body_opts/0 :: #{ length => non_neg_integer() | infinity, period => non_neg_integer(), timeout => timeout() }
  type req/0 :: #{ method := binary(), version := cowboy:http_version() | atom(), scheme := binary(), host := binary(), port := inet:port_number(), path := binary(), qs := binary(), headers := cowboy:http_headers(), peer := {inet:ip_address(), inet:port_number()}, sock := {inet:ip_address(), inet:port_number()}, cert := binary() | undefined, ref := ranch:ref(), pid := pid(), streamid := cowboy_stream:streamid(), host_info => cowboy_router:tokens(), path_info => cowboy_router:tokens(), bindings => cowboy_router:bindings(), has_body := boolean(), body_length := non_neg_integer() | undefined, has_read_body => true, multipart => {binary(), binary()} | done, has_sent_resp => headers | true, resp_cookies => #{iodata() => iodata()}, resp_headers => #{binary() => iodata()}, resp_body => resp_body(), proxy_header => ranch_proxy_header:proxy_info(), media_type => {binary(), binary(), [{binary(), binary()}]}, language => binary() | undefined, charset => binary() | undefined, range => {binary(), binary() | [{non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer() | infinity} | neg_integer()]}, websocket_version => 7 | 8 | 13, _ => _ }
  type resp_body/0 :: iodata() | {sendfile, non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), file:name_all()}

module cowboy_router
  behaviour cowboy_middleware
  export compile/1
  export execute/2
  export_type bindings/0
  export_type dispatch_rules/0
  export_type routes/0
  export_type tokens/0
  spec compile/1 compile(routes()) -> dispatch_rules()
  spec execute/2 execute(Req, Env) -> {ok, Req, Env}
       | {stop, Req} when Req::cowboy_req:req(), Env::cowboy_middleware:env()
  spec list_match/3 list_match(tokens(), dispatch_match(), bindings()) -> {true, bindings(), undefined | tokens()}
       | false
  spec match/3 match(dispatch_rules(), Host::binary() | tokens(), Path::binary()) -> {ok, module(), any(), bindings(), HostInfo::undefined | tokens(), PathInfo::undefined | tokens()}
       | {error, notfound, host}
       | {error, notfound, path}
       | {error, badrequest, path}
  spec match_path/4 match_path([dispatch_path()], HostInfo::undefined | tokens(), binary() | tokens(), bindings()) -> {ok, module(), any(), bindings(), HostInfo::undefined | tokens(), PathInfo::undefined | tokens()}
       | {error, notfound, path}
       | {error, badrequest, path}
  spec split_host/1 split_host(binary()) -> tokens()
  spec split_path/1 split_path(binary()) -> tokens() | badrequest
  type bindings/0 :: #{atom() => any()}
  type dispatch_match/0 :: '_' | <<_:8>> | [binary() | '_' | '...' | atom()]
  type dispatch_path/0 :: {dispatch_match(), cowboy:fields(), module(), any()}
  type dispatch_rule/0 :: {Host::dispatch_match(), cowboy:fields(), Paths::[dispatch_path()]}
  type route_match/0 :: '_' | iodata()
  type route_path/0 :: {Path::route_match(), Handler::module(), Opts::any()}
       | {Path::route_match(), cowboy:fields(), Handler::module(), Opts::any()}
  type route_rule/0 :: {Host::route_match(), Paths::[route_path()]}
       | {Host::route_match(), cowboy:fields(), Paths::[route_path()]}
  type routes/0 :: [route_rule()]
  type tokens/0 :: [binary()]
  opaque dispatch_rules/0

module cowboy_static
  export charsets_provided/2
  export content_types_provided/2
  export forbidden/2

  export ranges_provided/2

  export_type opts/0
  spec charsets_provided/2 charsets_provided(Req, State) -> {[binary()], Req, State} when State::state()
  spec content_types_provided/2 content_types_provided(Req, State) -> {[{binary(), get_file}], Req, State} when State::state()
  spec forbidden/2 forbidden(Req, State) -> {boolean(), Req, State} when State::state()
  spec generate_etag/2 generate_etag(Req, State) -> {{strong | weak, binary()}, Req, State} when State::state()
  spec get_file/2 get_file(Req, State) -> {{sendfile, 0, non_neg_integer(), binary()}, Req, State} when State::state()
  spec init/2 init(Req, opts()) -> {cowboy_rest, Req, error | state()} when Req::cowboy_req:req()
  spec last_modified/2 last_modified(Req, State) -> {calendar:datetime(), Req, State} when State::state()
  spec malformed_request/2 malformed_request(Req, State) -> {boolean(), Req, State}
  spec ranges_provided/2 ranges_provided(Req, State) -> {[{binary(), auto}], Req, State} when State::state()
  spec resource_exists/2 resource_exists(Req, State) -> {boolean(), Req, State} when State::state()
  type extra/0 :: [extra_charset() | extra_etag() | extra_mimetypes()]
  type extra_charset/0 :: {charset, module(), function()} | {charset, binary()}
  type extra_etag/0 :: {etag, module(), function()} | {etag, false}
  type extra_mimetypes/0 :: {mimetypes, module(), function()}
       | {mimetypes, binary() | {binary(), binary(), [{binary(), binary()}]}}
  type opts/0 :: {file | dir, string() | binary()}
       | {file | dir, string() | binary(), extra()}
       | {priv_file | priv_dir, atom(), string() | binary()}
       | {priv_file | priv_dir, atom(), string() | binary(), extra()}
  type state/0 :: {binary(), {direct | archive, #file_info{}} | {error, atom()}, extra()}

module cowboy_stream
  export data/4
  export early_error/5
  export info/3
  export init/3
  export make_error_log/5
  export terminate/3
  export_type commands/0
  export_type fin/0
  export_type partial_req/0
  export_type reason/0
  export_type resp_command/0
  export_type streamid/0
  callback data/4 data(streamid(), fin(), binary(), State) -> {commands(), State} when State::state()
  callback early_error/5 early_error(streamid(), reason(), partial_req(), Resp, cowboy:opts()) -> Resp when Resp::resp_command()
  callback info/3 info(streamid(), any(), State) -> {commands(), State} when State::state()
  callback init/3 init(streamid(), cowboy_req:req(), cowboy:opts()) -> {commands(), state()}
  callback terminate/3 terminate(streamid(), reason(), state()) -> any()
  spec data/4 data(streamid(), fin(), binary(), {Handler, State} | undefined) -> {commands(), {Handler, State} | undefined} when Handler::module(), State::state()
  spec early_error/5 early_error(streamid(), reason(), partial_req(), Resp, cowboy:opts()) -> Resp when Resp::resp_command()
  spec info/3 info(streamid(), any(), {Handler, State} | undefined) -> {commands(), {Handler, State} | undefined} when Handler::module(), State::state()
  spec init/3 init(streamid(), cowboy_req:req(), cowboy:opts()) -> {commands(), {module(), state()} | undefined}
  spec make_error_log/5 make_error_log(init | data | info | terminate | early_error, list(), error | exit | throw, any(), list()) -> {log, error, string(), list()}
  spec terminate/3 terminate(streamid(), reason(), {module(), state()} | undefined) -> ok
  type commands/0 :: [{inform, cowboy:http_status(), cowboy:http_headers()} | resp_command() | {headers, cowboy:http_status(), cowboy:http_headers()} | {data, fin(), cowboy_req:resp_body()} | {trailers, cowboy:http_headers()} | {push, binary(), binary(), binary(), inet:port_number(), binary(), binary(), cowboy:http_headers()} | {flow, pos_integer()} | {spawn, pid(), timeout()} | {error_response, cowboy:http_status(), cowboy:http_headers(), iodata()} | {switch_protocol, cowboy:http_headers(), module(), state()} | {internal_error, any(), human_reason()} | {set_options, map()} | {log, logger:level(), io:format(), list()} | stop]
  type fin/0 :: fin | nofin
  type human_reason/0 :: atom()
  type partial_req/0 :: map()
  type reason/0 :: normal
       | switch_protocol
       | {internal_error, timeout | {error | exit | throw, any()}, human_reason()}
       | {socket_error, closed | atom(), human_reason()}
       | {stream_error, cow_http2:error(), human_reason()}
       | {connection_error, cow_http2:error(), human_reason()}
       | {stop, cow_http2:frame() | {exit, any()}, human_reason()}
  type resp_command/0 :: {response, cowboy:http_status(), cowboy:http_headers(), cowboy_req:resp_body()}
  type state/0 :: any()
  type streamid/0 :: any()

module cowboy_websocket
  behaviour cowboy_sub_protocol
  export is_upgrade_request/1
  export loop/3
  export system_code_change/4
  export system_continue/3
  export system_terminate/4
  export takeover/7
  export upgrade/4
  export upgrade/5
  export_type commands/0
  export_type opts/0
  callback init/2 init(Req, any()) -> {ok | module(), Req, any()}
       | {module(), Req, any(), any()} when Req::cowboy_req:req()
  callback terminate/3 terminate(any(), cowboy_req:req(), any()) -> ok
  callback websocket_handle/2 websocket_handle(ping | pong | {text | binary | ping | pong, binary()}, State) -> call_result(State)
       | deprecated_call_result(State) when State::any()
  callback websocket_info/2 websocket_info(any(), State) -> call_result(State)
       | deprecated_call_result(State) when State::any()
  callback websocket_init/1 websocket_init(State) -> call_result(State)
       | deprecated_call_result(State) when State::any()
  optional_callback terminate/3
  optional_callback websocket_init/1
  spec handler_call_result/5 handler_call_result(#state{}, any(), parse_state(), fun(), commands()) -> no_return()
  spec is_upgrade_request/1 is_upgrade_request(cowboy_req:req()) -> boolean()
  spec loop/3 loop(#state{}, any(), parse_state()) -> no_return()
  spec loop_timeout/1 loop_timeout(#state{}) -> #state{}
  spec system_code_change/4 system_code_change(Misc, _, _, _) -> {ok, Misc} when Misc::{#state{}, any(), parse_state()}
  spec system_continue/3 system_continue(_, _, {#state{}, any(), parse_state()}) -> no_return()
  spec system_terminate/4 system_terminate(any(), _, _, {#state{}, any(), parse_state()}) -> no_return()
  spec takeover/7 takeover(pid(), ranch:ref(), inet:socket() | {pid(), cowboy_stream:streamid()}, module() | undefined, any(), binary(), {#state{}, any()}) -> no_return()
  spec terminate/3 terminate(#state{}, any(), terminate_reason()) -> no_return()
  spec upgrade/4 upgrade(Req, Env, module(), any()) -> {ok, Req, Env} when Req::cowboy_req:req(), Env::cowboy_middleware:env()
  spec upgrade/5 upgrade(Req, Env, module(), any(), opts()) -> {ok, Req, Env} when Req::cowboy_req:req(), Env::cowboy_middleware:env()
  spec websocket_close/3 websocket_close(#state{}, any(), terminate_reason()) -> no_return()
  spec websocket_handshake/4 websocket_handshake(#state{}, Req, any(), Env) -> {ok, Req, Env} when Req::cowboy_req:req(), Env::cowboy_middleware:env()
  spec websocket_send/2 websocket_send(cow_ws:frame(), #state{}) -> ok | stop | {error, atom()}
  type call_result/1 :: {commands(), State} | {commands(), State, hibernate}
  type commands/0 :: [cow_ws:frame() | {active, boolean()} | {deflate, boolean()} | {set_options, map()} | {shutdown_reason, any()} ]
  type deprecated_call_result/1 :: {ok, State}
       | {ok, State, hibernate}
       | {reply, cow_ws:frame() | [cow_ws:frame()], State}
       | {reply, cow_ws:frame() | [cow_ws:frame()], State, hibernate}
       | {stop, State}
  type opts/0 :: #{ active_n => pos_integer(), compress => boolean(), deflate_opts => cow_ws:deflate_opts(), idle_timeout => timeout(), max_frame_size => non_neg_integer() | infinity, req_filter => fun((cowboy_req:req()) -> map()), validate_utf8 => boolean() }
  type parse_state/0 :: #ps_header{} | #ps_payload{}
  type terminate_reason/0 :: normal
       | stop
       | timeout
       | remote
       | {remote, cow_ws:close_code(), binary()}
       | {error, badencoding | badframe | closed | atom()}
       | {crash, error | exit | throw, any()}
